description: Find UK pharmacies that dispense cannabis-based medicines against a prescription a clinic has already issued. Use `near` (postcode or town) for nearest first with miles; filter by delivery, in-person collection and review score. Returns up to 25 pharmacies at a time (page on with `offset`) with slug, page URL, town, distance, delivery and collection, and review score. A pharmacy cannot prescribe. It does not return stock, prices, or which products a pharmacy holds: those are shown only to patients and professionals with access. For delivery prices and GPhC registration use get_listing, or compare_providers for several.

delivers.description: Only pharmacies that deliver (most dispense UK-wide by post).

minRating.description: Only pharmacies with patient reviews averaging 3+ or 4+.

near.description: A UK postcode, outcode or town, e.g. "M1 1AE", "LS6" or "Bristol". Sorts nearest first and adds miles.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page (the answer says which offset comes next). Default 0.

query.description: Pharmacy name, matched as text. For a place use `near`.

radiusMiles.description: Only within this many miles of `near`. Ignored without `near`.

sort.description: distance (default with `near`), az (default otherwise), za, city, rating.

name: find_pharmacies

distanceMiles.description: Miles from `near`; null when no place was given

rating.description: Published patient reviews; null when there are none

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find dispensing pharmacies
